summary_en: This documentary explores the river landscapes, traditional livelihoods, and cultural heritage along the Vam Nao River and the Mekong Delta. It features scenes of waterway transportation, fishing activities, artisanal rice paper manufacturing, folk music performances, and personal reflections from local residents.
